data.one_liner: Style custom text snippets with bookmarks, links, and functions easily.
data.what_it_does: SuperRichText allows developers to easily format specific text snippets using markers like bold, italics, or custom strings. It supports adding clickable URLs and custom functions directly into specific occurrences within the text.
use_when: You need to style specific parts of a text string using custom markers.
You want to embed links or callback functions inside inline text.
avoid_when: You are using complex rich text structures that heavily rely on standard Flutter InlineSpan trees without markdown-like syntax.
strengths: Simplifies adding custom styles, links, and functions to text snippets.
Supports both local and global custom markers.
weaknesses: Relies on custom string markers which may be less robust than full markdown parsers for complex documents.
